description: Validate LLM output: repair JSON, enforce schema, check grounding against a source, extract citations. Use when you need to check or repair a model answer: parse and fix broken JSON, validate against a schema, compare with a source for unsupported claims, extract citations. Example input: {"output":"{\"total\": 42,}","schema":{"type":"object"},"source":"optional source text"}. Returns: verdict, json{parseable,fixes_applied,value}, schema, grounding, citations.
name: agent_output_validator
